comment: Only Prof. Williams can make civ pro, quite honestly one of the hardest 1L classes you will face, your favorite class. Not only did he care about my performance in civ pro, he helped me become a writer for my other classes. I consider myself very lucky to be placed in his section.

One of the best professors I have ever had.  The class itself is inherently difficult, dry and boring but he makes it accessible and understandable.  He cold calls and asks very detailed questions about the case you are called for.  He is always ready for students during his office hours, is very nice and an absolutely incredible professor.

The Sheriff was a great teacher.  Once you get past Pennoyer v. Neff and personal jurisdiction, things get easier.  Dean Willimas manages to teach even PJ with a sense of clarity, and the rest of the semester seems like kiddie stuff after that.  Excellent grasp of federal civil procedure and probably other aspects of the law.

GREAT professor. Covers an extremely dense subject in a clear way. Asking him a question makes it ever clearer, he actually answers!!! Absolutely brilliant, knows everything about everything in the law.
Dean Williams is one of the best professors I have ever had, and one of the finest people I have had the pleasure to meet.  The law school is lucky to have him.

Dean Williams takes an incredibly frustrating and difficult subject and makes it reasonably clear! Anyone who ever took Civ Pro knows what a nasty furball it can be- Dean Williams, in between scaring you to death, teaches you how to comb out that furball and slap some product on it.
